---
title: "Index for Reports"
author: "Kentaro Murayama"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output: html_document
---


```{r, reports}
prgs <- c("Accounting", "Business Core", "Economics", "Finance",
          "Human Resources Management", "Management", "Marketing",
          "MIS", "MBA")
codes <- c("ACC", "BUS", "ECO", "FIN", "HRM", "MGM", "MKT", "MIS", "MBA")
for (i in 1:length(prgs)){
  prg <- prgs[i]
  code <- codes[i]
  rmarkdown::render("report-template.Rmd", params = list(program = prg, code = code),
                    output_file = paste0("Report-", prg, ".docx"))
}
```
